services:

  postgres:
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    container_name: finance-monolith-postgres

    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: finance

      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance
      TZ: UTC
      PGTZ: UTC

    ports:

      timeout: 5s

    container_name: finance-monolith-app

    working_dir: /workspace

    volumes:
      - ./financial-monolith:/workspace
      - finance_monolith_maven_cache:/root/.m2

    ports:
      - "8080:8080"

    environment:
      SPRING_DATASOURCE_URL: jdbc:postgresql://postgres:5432/finance

      SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD: finance
      TZ: UTC
      JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS: -Duser.timezone=UTC

    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy

    command:
      - mvn
      - spring-boot:run

  postgres-test:

    container_name: finance-monolith-postgres-test

    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: finance_test
      POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
      TZ: UTC

      timeout: 5s
      retries: 10

  datasource:

    username: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_USERNAME:finance}
    password: ${SPRING_DATASOURCE_PASSWORD:finance}

  port: 8080

    web:

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>

<project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="
            http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0
            https://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd">

    <modelVersion>4.0.0</modelVersion>

    <parent>
        <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
        <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-parent</artifactId>
        <version>3.5.0</version>
        <relativePath/>
    </parent>

    <groupId>com.juanesteban.tcc</groupId>
    <artifactId>financial-monolith</artifactId>
    <version>0.0.1-SNAPSHOT</version>

    <name>financial-monolith</name>

    <description>
        Monolithic implementation for financial architecture benchmark
    </description>

    <properties>
        <java.version>21</java.version>
    </properties>

    <dependencies>

        <!-- REST -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-web</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- JPA -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-data-jpa</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- PostgreSQL -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.postgresql</groupId>
            <artifactId>postgresql</artifactId>
            <scope>runtime</scope>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Validation -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-validation</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Actuator -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-actuator</artifactId>
        </dependency>

        <!-- Tests -->
        <dependency>
            <groupId>org.springframework.boot</groupId>
            <artifactId>spring-boot-starter-test</artifactId>
            <scope>test</scope>
        </dependency>

    </dependencies>

    <build>

        <plugins>

            <plugin>

                <groupId>
                    org.springframework.boot
                </groupId>

                <artifactId>
                    spring-boot-maven-plugin
                </artifactId>

            </plugin>

            <plugin>

                <groupId>
                    org.jacoco
                </groupId>

                <artifactId>
                    jacoco-maven-plugin
                </artifactId>

                <version>
                    0.8.13
                </version>

                <executions>

                    <execution>

                        <goals>
                            <goal>
                                prepare-agent
                            </goal>
                        </goals>

                    </execution>


                    <execution>

                        <id>
                            jacoco-report
                        </id>

                        <phase>
                            verify
                        </phase>

                        <goals>
                            <goal>
                                report
                            </goal>
                        </goals>

                    </execution>

                </executions>

            </plugin>

        </plugins>

    </build>

</project>package com.juanesteban.tcc.finance;

import org.springframework.boot.SpringApplication;
import org.springframework.boot.autoconfigure.SpringBootApplication;

@SpringBootApplication
public class FinancialMonolithApplication {

    public static void main(String[] args) {

        SpringApplication.run(
            FinancialMonolithApplication.class,
            args
        );

    }
}

content.text:
Build passes. I didn't smoke-test the endpoints, because the rules bar me from running `docker compose up`.

**Created** (all under `financial-monolith/src/main/java/com/juanesteban/tcc/finance/`):
- `domain/`: `AppUser`, `Position`, `Trade`. These are the JPA entities, and the tables are created by the existing `ddl-auto: update`.
- `repo/`: `AppUserRepository`, `PositionRepository`, `TradeRepository`. The user repository has a pessimistic-lock query used by trades.
- `service/`: `QuoteService` (the fixed quotes), `TradingService` (user creation, buy, sell, portfolio and history lookups) and `ApiException`.
- `web/`: `ApiController` (all 6 endpoints) and `GlobalExceptionHandler`.

I didn't modify `pom.xml`, `application.yml` or `docker-compose.yml`.

**Command run:** `docker compose run --rm --no-deps app mvn -q -B package -DskipTests`. It finished with no errors, so there was nothing to fix.

**Behaviour:**
- **Users:** a new user starts with 10000.00 and gets 201. A duplicate or blank username gets 400. The response includes the UUID as both `id` and `userId`.
- **Quotes:** `GET /api/quotes/{symbol}` returns 200 for a known symbol and 400 for an unknown one.
- **Trades:** buy and sell return 201. Shares ≤ 0 or missing, an unknown symbol, insufficient cash and insufficient position all return 400. An unknown user gets 404. Each trade runs in one transaction with the user row locked, so a rejected trade changes neither cash nor position.
- **Validation order:** shares and symbol are checked before the user lookup. A request that is invalid in both ways gets 400 rather than 404. The contract doesn't say which should win.
- **Malformed input:** a bad UUID or unparseable JSON gets 400.
- **Portfolio:** returns `cash`, `cashBalance`, `holdings` (with `symbol`, `shares`, `price`, `marketValue`) and `totalValue`. Positions with zero shares are left out of `holdings`.
- **History:** `GET /api/users/{userId}/trades` returns an array in chronological order, each item with `type` set to `BUY` or `SELL`.

**State:** the implementation is complete and compiles. The runtime behaviour is untested, so the orchestrator's acceptance run is the first real check.
